title: Five early Christian writings
summary: Five writings of the early church, outside the New Testament, now have a Plain English Translation from the Greek, with study notes, manuscript differences and chapter pages: the Didache, a manual of Christian life and worship; the Epistle of Barnabas; 1 Clement, a letter from the church at Rome to the church at Corinth; Polycarp to the Philippians; and the Martyrdom of Polycarp. Eleven new topic pages come with them, among them Peace, the Apostolic Fathers, Polycarp and Succession from the Apostles, and notes across the Bible now point to where these writings quote it.
